Container.Name: FinTV
Container.Overview:
FinTV creates virtual 24/7 TV channels from the Jellyfin media library and delivers them as an HLS stream. This container is the FinTV service; it also serves the Jellyfin plugin.
Setup: 0. Before the first start, run these commands in the Unraid terminal: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/fintv and chown 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/fintv. The container runs as 99:100; otherwise Docker creates the directory as root and the service stops with "Applying database migrations failed" in the log. 1. Set the API key (at least 32 characters; generate one with "openssl rand -hex 32", for example) and mount the media share under /media. Set the path mapping (From = path in Jellyfin, To = path in the container) so that the service finds the same files as Jellyfin. 2. Start the container and check http://[IP]:8098/health. 3. In Jellyfin, go to Dashboard, Plugins, Repositories, add the repository http://[IP]:8098/plugin/manifest.json, install FinTV from the catalog and restart Jellyfin. Then enter the service URL and the same API key on the plugin page.
Note: The plugin repository is reachable without a login; anyone on the LAN who can reach the port can download the plugin (it contains no secrets).
NVENC (optional, NVIDIA GPU): The Unraid plugin "Nvidia-Driver" must be installed. Add --runtime=nvidia under "Extra Parameters" (in addition to --user 99:100), set the variable FinTV__Streaming__Encoder to h264_nvenc and add the variables NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES (GPU UUID or all) and NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,video,utility. The service checks the encoder at startup; if it cannot be used, it stops with an error message in the log.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Data directory (database, thumbnails, segments). Must be owned by 99:100.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Shared key with the plugin, at least 32 characters.

Config.Name: Path mapping from (Jellyfin)
Config.Description: Path under which Jellyfin sees the media.

Config.Name: Path mapping to (container)
Config.Description: Path under which the service sees the media.

Config.Name: Encoder
Config.Description: libx264 (CPU) or h264_nvenc (NVIDIA GPU, see the description).

Config.Name: Max. concurrent streams
Config.Description: Maximum number of streams running at the same time.
